# UBUNYE Safety & Compliance

> UBUNYE Safety & Compliance is a South African SHEQ, OHS and ISO consulting business providing risk management, safety compliance and safety training for industrial and corporate businesses. Website: https://ubunye.weybrand.co.za

Contact: ubunyesafety@gmail.com | Nolan (Eastern Cape): 083 646 7294 | Mick (training courses only in Limpopo and Mpumalanga): 060 949 9911 | WhatsApp: 067 577 9148

Regional availability: Nolan provides training, consulting, ISO support, OHS compliance audits and wider SHEQ services in the Eastern Cape. Mick provides training courses only in Limpopo and Mpumalanga.

## Services
- [SHEQ consulting](https://ubunye.weybrand.co.za/services/sheq-consulting): Safety, health, environment and quality guidance that connects your policies, people and day-to-day operations.
- [OHS compliance](https://ubunye.weybrand.co.za/services/ohs-compliance): Compliance reviews, OHS audits, gap identification, documentation support and practical action planning.
- [ISO consulting](https://ubunye.weybrand.co.za/services/iso-consulting): Support for ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001: gap analysis, documentation, implementation and readiness.
- [Risk assessments](https://ubunye.weybrand.co.za/services/risk-assessments): Hazard identification, risk rating and practical controls, recorded in a clear written assessment.
- [Safety files](https://ubunye.weybrand.co.za/services/safety-files): Preparation and review of organised health and safety files that show how your business manages safety.
- [Safety training](https://ubunye.weybrand.co.za/services/safety-training): First Aid Level 1, Fire Fighting, OHS SHE Representative, Legal Liability, Working at Heights and Incident Investigations. UBUNYE confirms these courses are verified through SAIOSH. Current training arrangements are made directly; the online learning platform is planned and not yet live.
- [SAIOSH corporate membership certificate](https://ubunye.weybrand.co.za/saiosh-corporate-membership-certificate.pdf): Original certificate PDF, published unchanged.
- [Incident investigation](https://ubunye.weybrand.co.za/services/incident-investigation): Independent support to establish what happened, why it happened and what needs to change.
- [SHEQ retainers](https://ubunye.weybrand.co.za/retainers): Ongoing SHEQ compliance support.
